hotels.title: Bali Beachfront Bliss: Adults-Only Suites & Villas with Daily Breakfast & Nightly Cocktails
hotels.description: If you’re looking to get away from it all amid the raw beauty of Bali, look no further than this soul-soothing paradise. This secluded adults-only retreat features a collection of Balinese-inspired jacuzzi suites and private pool villas, inviting you to relax in barefoot luxury. The real crown jewel is the impressive oceanfront infinity pool framed by cabanas and sun loungers, leading onto the black-sand, palm-fringed Purnama Beach. An array of international culinary creations will delight gourmands at Standing Stones Beach Restaurant, or retreat to the high-end Moonstone Beach Lounge next door for an open-air beach lounge, restaurant and bar encircled by a dazzling swimming pool and glorious cabanas. For moments of unrivalled relaxation, the blissful Black Sand Spa is inspired by the therapeutic properties of local volcanic sand, offering a truly unique treatment.
